# `dac_spi` register map

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_regmap.py from regmap/dac_spi.yaml. Do not edit. -->

SPI DAC driver covering the Digilent PmodDA2 (two DAC121S101, 12-bit) and PmodDA3 (AD5541A, 16-bit, with an LDAC strobe). The serial engine is shared; DEVICE selects the frame format and width, so one bitstream can drive either module without a rebuild.

6 registers, 24 bytes.

| Offset | Name | Access | Reset | Description |
| ------ | ---- | ------ | ----- | ----------- |
| `0x00` | `CTRL` | rw | `0x00000000` | Run control. LOAD and LDAC are write-1-to-act and clear themselves. |
| `0x04` | `CFG` | rw | `0x00000004` | Serial-interface configuration. |
| `0x08` | `DATA0` | rw | `0x00000000` | Channel 0 code. 12-bit for PmodDA2, 16-bit for PmodDA3. Upper bits are ignored. |
| `0x0C` | `DATA1` | rw | `0x00000000` | Channel 1 code. PmodDA2 only; ignored for single-channel devices. |
| `0x10` | `STATUS` | ro | `0x00000000` | Live engine state. |
| `0x14` | `READBACK` | ro | `0x00000000` | Last frame actually shifted out, as seen by the engine. Distinct from DATA0/DATA1 so the host can tell "value staged" from "value delivered" -- the single most useful thing to have when a DAC output looks wrong. |

## `CTRL` (`0x00`, rw)

Run control. LOAD and LDAC are write-1-to-act and clear themselves.

| Bits | Field | Description |
| ---- | ----- | ----------- |
| `4` | `LDAC_HOLD` | Hold LDAC asserted so transfers update the output immediately. |
| `3` | `LDAC` | Self-clearing: pulse the LDAC pin (PmodDA3) to move the shifted value into the DAC latch. |
| `2` | `AUTO` | Start a transfer automatically whenever DATA0 or DATA1 is written. |
| `1` | `LOAD` | Self-clearing: shift DATA0/DATA1 out now. |
| `0` | `ENABLE` | Enable the serial engine. Held low |

## `CFG` (`0x04`, rw)

Serial-interface configuration.

| Bits | Field | Description |
| ---- | ----- | ----------- |
| `29:24` | `WIDTH` | Frame length in bits for DEVICE = raw. Ignored otherwise. |
| `17:16` | `DEVICE` | 0 = PmodDA2 (DAC121S101, 12-bit, 2ch), 1 = PmodDA3 (AD5541A, 16-bit, 1ch), 2 = raw frame. |
| `9` | `CPHA` | Sampling edge. PmodDA2 and PmodDA3 both use mode 0. |
| `8` | `CPOL` | SCLK idle level. |
| `7:0` | `CLK_DIV` | SCLK half-period in aclk cycles minus one. SCLK = f_aclk / (2*(CLK_DIV+1)). |

## `DATA0` (`0x08`, rw)

Channel 0 code. 12-bit for PmodDA2, 16-bit for PmodDA3. Upper bits are ignored.

| Bits | Field | Description |
| ---- | ----- | ----------- |
| `15:0` | `CODE` | Straight-binary DAC code. |

## `DATA1` (`0x0C`, rw)

Channel 1 code. PmodDA2 only; ignored for single-channel devices.

| Bits | Field | Description |
| ---- | ----- | ----------- |
| `15:0` | `CODE` | Straight-binary DAC code. |

## `STATUS` (`0x10`, ro)

Live engine state.

| Bits | Field | Description |
| ---- | ----- | ----------- |
| `31:8` | `XFER_COUNT` | Completed frames since reset. Wraps. |
| `1` | `LDAC_ACTIVE` | The LDAC pin is currently asserted. |
| `0` | `BUSY` | A frame is being shifted out. |
